title: prunella vulgaris subsp. surrecta
intro: Prunella vulgaris subsp. surrecta, commonly known as self-heal, is a subspecies of plant in the mint family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and research has shown that it possesses various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of P. vulgaris subsp. surrecta are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
